Specification: This module defines a record value and an operator that accesses a nonexistent field of that record. The comments state that the record has fields `name` and `a`, and that the purpose of the second operator is to demonstrate an unsafe record access that should be reported as a type error by a type checker. The specification does not model a transition system, has no variables or temporal behavior, and serves as a minimal static typing example focused on record construction and field selection.
